title: OmniCapBench

items: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
786 videos with localized structural and semantic evaluation
arXiv v1, October 2026

note: 核心贡献是把长文本整体评分拆为可定位的结构单元，再进行局部语义检查。

title: Global caption scores hide local errors

items: A fluent paragraph can omit an event, confuse entity identity, or misplace a timestamp.
One scalar score mixes perception, temporal alignment, and language style.
The benchmark seeks separate diagnostics for what happened and when/where it happened.

note: caption 流畅不等于理解正确，但新的结构化任务也会引入指令遵循能力的影响。

title: Three dependent native tracks
note: 源于 MTSS 的解耦设计，论文细化 subshot 与连续时间范围。ID、时间与 cross-link 共同构成结构约束。

title: Construction follows dependency order

items: Candidate videos pass audio, duration, quality, and density filters.
Generation builds references before events and shots.
An iterative evaluator/validator/refinement loop checks structure while enriching descriptions.

note: 局部文字 refinement 保持 ID、时间与 links 不变，避免语言润色改变已确认拓扑。第 3.1 节。

title: Native unit generation exposes explicit structure

items: The model receives a video and returns structured JSON tracks.
Generation must create defined references and valid temporal links.
This task evaluates structure production together with perceptual and semantic understanding.

note: 不能声称 JSON 把模型内部 reasoning 直接变成可观测真值。它只是要求显式输出的评测协议。

title: Validation precedes semantic judgment

items: Undefined IDs, reversed intervals, and impossible links fail deterministic checks.
Shots and events match by temporal intersection-over-union.
References and subshots use bounded local LLM-assisted matching.

note: 并非所有 matching 都是纯规则。必须保留 matcher 模型、prompt 与候选配对结果以审计偏差。

title: Semantic scores operate on aligned units

items: Only structurally valid and matched units receive bounded semantic-equivalence scoring.
Unmatched or invalid units remain structural errors.
Separate metric families expose identity, temporal, and audio–visual grounding weaknesses.

note: 语义分数的分母与结构召回不同，不能只选语义高分而忽略大量未匹配单元。

title: Selected reported structural metrics
note: 表 3 数值。SGC 与 CCC、EVSA 的含义不同，schema 高分不能推断跨镜头身份追踪正确。

title: Benchmark comparisons have task boundaries

items: The study compares proprietary and open omnimodal model families.
Specialized free-form captioning models struggle with structured instruction following.
The paper excludes those specialized models from the main structured evaluation.

note: 这种排除说明评测协议会影响可比较模型集合，不能据此宣称 specialized captioner 全面弱于通用模型。

title: Reference and judge bias remain

items: 786 curated videos provide diagnostic depth rather than exhaustive domain coverage.
Automatic generation, local refinement, and LLM matching can share model biases.
API versions, fallback behavior, and semantic judges affect repeatability.

note: 结构化减少整体 judge 的模糊性，却没有消除语义判断和标注的不确定性。需保留人工审计样本。

title: Evaluation platform application proposal

items: Inference: store entity IDs, intervals, and cross-links as versioned annotation tables.
Proposed application: report schema validity, matching recall, and semantic quality separately.
Proposed application: route localized failure types to targeted relabeling or model tests.

note: 为错误建立可追踪定位比单个总分更适合数据质量迭代，但需要明确 schema 演进策略。

title: Reproduction and acceptance gates

items: Pin the dataset release, schema, model API versions, matcher, and prompts.
Replay validation with corrupt IDs and time spans to verify failure accounting.
Double-label a stratified human sample and report judge agreement and per-duration slices.
